Definition: to turn; by implication, to face, i.e. appear, look, etc.
BiblicalUsage: Pânâh is to turn, to face, to look toward. Elijah is told to turn eastward and hide by the brook Cherith, Judah turns toward the watch tower and sees only dead bodies, Moses looks this way and that way before he strikes the Egyptian, and Solomon asks the LORD to have respect unto the prayer of His servant.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe turning is the first motion of faith. Elijah turns to hide, Moses turns to look, and Solomon asks God to turn toward His people's prayer.
